action_instruction: Waiting briefly after reviewing the Paris to New York flight results table
intent: PRIMARY: wait briefly after reviewing the Paris to New York flight results heading and table
rationale: The heading, required columns, and five row actions are visible and reviewed.

intent: whether the flight results heading includes the departure and arrival cities

action_params.condition: the heading includes Paris and New York
action_params.query: whether the flight results heading includes the departure and arrival cities

action_instruction: Checking the flight results table columns
intent: whether the flight results table displays Airline, Flight #, departure time, arrival time, and Price columns

action_params.condition: the table shows Airline, Flight #, Departure Time, Arrival Time, and Price columns
action_params.query: whether the flight results table displays Airline, Flight #, departure time, arrival time, and Price columns
action_params.code_js: (() => { const h = Array.from(el(4).querySelectorAll('th')).map(x => x.textContent.trim()); return h.some(x => x === 'Airline') && h.some(x => x === 'Flight #') && h.some(x => /Departs:/i.test(x)) && h.some(x => /Arrives:/i.test(x)) && h.some(x => x === 'Price'); })()
locators: internal:text="Choose Flight # Airline Departs: Paris Arrives: New York Price Choose This"i

action_instruction: Checking flight selection actions in all displayed rows
intent: whether every displayed flight result row includes a Choose This Flight action

action_params.condition: every displayed flight row includes a Choose This Flight action
action_params.query: whether every displayed flight result row includes a Choose This Flight action
action_params.code_js: (() => { const rows = Array.from(el(4).querySelectorAll('tr')).filter(r => r.querySelectorAll('td').length > 0); return rows.length > 0 && rows.every(r => Array.from(r.querySelectorAll('button,input[type="submit"],input[type="button"]')).some(a => a.value === 'Choose This Flight' || a.textContent.trim() === 'Choose This Flight')); })()
locators: internal:text="Choose Flight # Airline Departs: Paris Arrives: New York Price Choose This"i

assertion_tree.description: the heading includes Paris and New York, the table shows Airline, Flight #, Departure Time, Arrival Time, and Price columns, and every displayed flight row includes a Choose This Flight action

sub_results.description: the heading includes Paris and New York
the table shows Airline, Flight #, Departure Time, Arrival Time, and Price columns
every displayed flight row includes a Choose This Flight action

assertion_tree.verification: The flight results heading includes Paris and New York; the flights table has columns Airline, Flight #, Departure Time, Arrival Time, and Price; and each displayed flight row has a Choose This Flight action.
